title: 油价跌回每桶98美元 沙特有望重启管道
summary: 此前油价一度飙升至每桶109.97美元，原因是在一系列无人机袭击破坏东西向输油管道后，沙特阿拉伯在近两周前关闭了该管道。

title: 特朗普敦促泽连斯基停止袭击俄炼油厂
summary: 美国总统将全球柴油价格上涨归咎于俄乌战争，而非他发动的美伊冲突。据悉他向乌方传递的核心信息是“柴油、柴油、柴油”。

title: Too early to say whether Iran involved in Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack, Israeli PM says
summary: A pilot who stabbed another pilot on an Israel-bound plane is being investigated in Saudi Arabia, Benjamin Netanyahu says.

title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
summary: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.
